newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China buys 30,000T U.S. soymeal at $270 C&F.
newsitem.headline: China buys 30,000T U.S. soymeal at $270 C&F.

text.p: Chinese buyers have bought about 30,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for December to January delivery at about US$270 a tonne C&F, traders said on Tuesday.
They said China would purchase more U.S. soymeal if prices dip towards $265 from current offers between $270 to $280.
"Buyers are waiting to source at better prices around US$265 per tonne," one trader said.
But Chinese interest in U.S. soybeans remains subdued.
"Chinese buyers are not interested in buying U.S. soybeans at the current prices around $310 a tonne (C&F)," a trader said.
Traders said the weather in U.S. soybean growing areas remains the key factor for the market.
China is unlikely to import corn this year due to sufficient government corn stocks, they added.
